title: PixelKin - The Wakeful Fair
_note: The coffee festival in the striped marquee on Wayward Rise (S7). A jaunty fairground two-step in F: a hummable pulse25 tune (AB, 16 bars), oom-pah tri_bass, an organ 'pah' on every offbeat like a fairground band, a pluck arpeggio, a bell every other bar. Bar 16 runs C7 up to the top C and walks the bass G-Bb back into bar 1's F. The family's anchor: -buzz / -trip / -dream / battle-wakeful-buzz all play THIS tune.
